meta.name: performance-report
meta.description: Generate affiliate performance reports with KPIs and recommendations. Triggers on: "show my affiliate report", "how are my programs doing", "performance review", "earnings report", "monthly affiliate report", "weekly report", "analyze my affiliate earnings", "which program is best", "EPC report", "conversion rate analysis", "revenue breakdown", "campaign performance".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成联盟营销绩效报表并获取优化建议
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要定期查看联盟项目收益与转化表现
copy.tagline_en: Generate affiliate performance reports with optimization tips
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage affiliate programs and need regular performance insights

howto.what: 当用户提供联盟营销数据（如点击、转化、收入）时，Claude会生成一份绩效报告，包含KPI仪表盘、节目排名、趋势分析和具体行动建议。
howto.when: 当用户说“显示我的联盟报告”、“我的节目表现如何”等，或用户提供点击、转化、收入数据并要求分析时触发。

say.text: 帮我生成上个月的联盟营销报告
say.note: 需提前提供节目名称及数据

say.text: 分析这些节目的EPC和转化率
比较这周和上周的HeyGen数据

howto.what_en: When users provide affiliate marketing data (clicks, conversions, revenue, etc.), Claude generates a performance report with KPI dashboard, program rankings, trend analysis, and actionable recommendations.
howto.when_en: Triggers when users say 'show my affiliate report', 'how are my programs doing', or provide click/conversion/revenue data for analysis.

say_en.note: Need program names and metrics first

say_en.text: Analyze EPC and conversion rates for these programs
Compare this week vs last week for HeyGen
